author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: Canonical record for Counter-Clock World, PKD's novel, preserving a single archive manifestation.
page_summary:
Counter-Clock World is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is Counter-Clock World (1967).

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.

biography_events.event: PKD's COUNTER-CLOCK WORLD is published by Berkley Books; PKD notes the cover-art girl resembles Nancy and the protagonist Lotta is modeled on her.
